result.description: Portable archival storage designed for museum registrars, field researchers, and documentary crews who need quiet, dust-tolerant capacity for notes, scans, and raw media. The Field Archive uses a durable sealed enclosure, USB-C connectivity, and balanced power draw for long cataloging sessions. It emphasizes dependable bulk storage over speed, making it a practical shuttle drive for offsite collections and temporary backups.
